$comment: The Agents Marketplace, in two parts. toolkit: the tools every AI needs to succeed, set up together by skills/toolkit/SKILL.md. worlds: a tool's whole world, set up by skills/<id>/SKILL.md. Install any part with `npx skills add SolenixAI/agents-marketplace --skill <toolkit|id>`. This file names sources only; solenix.dev/agents reads every number (stars, versions, installs) live from them. scripts/check.ts validates it.

toolkit.for: The tools every AI needs to succeed. First: finding and installing the right skill for anything you ask.

tools.name: Skills
tools.for: Your AI finds and installs the right skill for anything you ask, from the open skills ecosystem.

worlds.name: Vercel
worlds.for: Put your website and apps online, keep them fast, and let your AI deploy and fix them for you. (live test)
